body:
ok i need you to go do something for me, because this one still makes me gasp.

in the 'bejeweled' video there's a blink-and-you-miss-it moment in an elevator: two floor buttons glow. button 3 in purple. button 5 in blue. at the time it just looked pretty.

months later she re-recorded Speak Now (her third album, purple) and 1989 (her fifth, blue). she'd told us the order, in an elevator, and most of us didn't clock it until it happened.

so — the challenge: open The Clue Web, find the elevator clue, and tell me which two floors lit up and what they turned out to mean. reply with what you got 👇

it lives under Threads on the site. 📷 the eras tour, minneapolis 2023 — michael hicks (cc by 2.0), via wikimedia commons. swipe for the clue web.
